method: Mirror of the opcode payload schemas pass on the s2c side: parse 1.x BasePacket (decompressing zlib bodies when is_compressed=1) + SubPacket + GameMessage framing; for each target s2c opcode collect all emissions across the 54-scenario corpus filtered to server -> client streams (private-IP heuristic identifies the client endpoint per pair); if samples share inner-body length compute per-byte-offset entropy buckets (invariant / low / medium / high) and run-length compress invariant regions; surface ASCII-string spans and per-u32-window cardinality. The result is the empirical receiver-side wire field layout.
